lines: Good morning my love. If you need any heavy lifting done on the farm today, just say the word.
$1Consider it an official request.
You're back late. I was tempted to bring you home...
$1Come, sit down. Tell me about your day.
Being your partner in this quiet valley... it is a victory I never sought,
$4yet it is the greatest one I have.
This space is... peaceful. I am unaccustomed to luxury,
$2but a soldier appreciates a well-maintained base of operations. Not to brag but...
$4I get to wake up beside the best view in the entire valley everyday.
I tried to feed the chickens.
$7They completely ignored my authority!
$5I suppose my presence isn't very... vexing to a flock of birds.
$7It was... humbling.
The rain reminds me of the storms over Midgar,
$2but there is no acid in this water. It is just... nature.
$6Stay inside today if you can. I do not wish for you to catch a cold.
My movements are... slowing down.
$8Not from age! it's because the edge is gone!
$1I no longer feel the need to destroy. I only feel the urge to protect this land.
$6To protect you.
$1Good morning, {{playerName}}. I brewed fresh tea while you were still asleep—I hope it is to your liking.
$3Once, my mornings began with briefings and steel. Waking up to sunlight on the floorboards and the sound of your breathing is a peace I still struggle to put into words.
$8You were already out the door before dawn yesterday. Even a SOLDIER needs proper rest, {{playerName}}.
$6Promise me you will pause for a proper meal at midday. If you will not slow down for your own sake, do it for mine.
$1I found a volume on local botany in the bookshelf earlier. It is remarkable how much life thrives here without interference.
$3Whenever you come back inside, the book immediately loses my attention—though I suppose I do not mind that at all.
$0Sometimes I catch myself simply standing in the kitchen, listening to the clock tick.
$2There are no emergencies waiting beyond the door. No voices calling me away.
$1Only a quiet home, and the person who gave me a second chance at life. Have a safe day out there, {{playerName}}.
$1I tidied the entryway and checked the pantry stores this morning. Everything is in order.
$1Whenever your work is done, come straight back to me. I will be waiting.
The rain against the roof used to remind me of long, bleak campaigns far from home.
$1Now, listening to it while watching you move about the farmhouse... it is the most soothing sound in the world.
The mud along the southern path looks treacherous today. Mind your footing out there, {{playerName}}.
$1If you come back chilled to the bone, I will have warm towels and hot broth waiting by the hearth.
$8You are soaked through, {{playerName}}. Come step closer to the fire before you catch a chill.
$1Let the storm rage outside all it wishes—nothing can touch us within these walls.
On nights like this, old memories occasionally knock at the door... yet they no longer hold any power over me.
$4One glance at you, {{playerName}}, and all the shadows scatter. Thank you for being my anchor.
$1I walked the perimeter of the fields earlier. Everything is quiet, save for the wind in the crops.
$1To nurture life from the soil rather than take it... I think I finally understand why you love this work so much.
$0Do not mind me—I was only taking in the fresh air.
$1Though I will admit, watching you tend the farm is far more captivating than the scenery.
$1The mountain air clears the mind wonderfully.
$1I was just reflecting on how far we have come since the day I first arrived in this valley. Whatever lies ahead, {{playerName}}, I am grateful to walk it beside you.
$1Welcome home, {{playerName}}. You look exhausted—let me take care of the rest of the evening.
$1Set your tools aside and rest for a while. You do not have to carry every burden on your own anymore.
$1Another peaceful day has come to a close.
$1Go on to bed whenever you are ready, {{playerName}}. I will extinguish the lamps and join you shortly.
Before I fell into this valley, I believed warmth and trust were weaknesses meant for ordinary people.
$1You dismantled every defense I ever built without raising a single blade, {{playerName}}. I am endlessly glad you did.
